title: Meet FlexTek
style_prompt: Friendly flat-color cartoon illustration, bold outlines, warm lighting, 16:9.
character_description: A cheerful bald cartoon man with a short beard, wearing a navy polo shirt and headset.

scenes.narration: Hi, I'm glad you're here. Today I want to show you how a small technical team can punch way above its weight.
scenes.image_prompt: The character waves at the camera in a bright modern office.

scenes.narration: Most businesses don't need more tools. They need the right few, set up properly, and someone who actually understands them.
scenes.image_prompt: The character stands in front of a whiteboard with a simple diagram of three connected boxes.

scenes.narration: That's what we do. We fix what's broken, simplify what's messy, and build what's missing.
scenes.image_prompt: The character holds a wrench and a laptop, smiling, with a city skyline behind.
